name: Referred Mandate Document 2
definition: Identifies the documents referred to in the remittance information.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the type of referred document.

Number.name: Number
Number.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the referred document.

CreditorReference.name: Creditor Reference
CreditorReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification as assigned by the creditor to the referred document shared with the debtor for its own reference.

RelatedDate.name: Related Date
RelatedDate.definition: Date and type associated with the referred document.
